notes.title: Version V0.2 has been released! You can now play levels 1-8!
notes.notes: Welcome to version v0.2! This version adds a CG recollection feature to the pig farm, adjusts the position of the exit button, and allows you to play levels 1-8!! By the way, pressing 【Tab】 in the CG interface can hide the dialogue box! Thank you for your support, I will continue to work hard!
